title: K5: the learner says they changed another layer by mistake and undid it. No check saw that, so the saved record never pairs a change word with Subtitle; if the first save is refused, the mentor rewrites and saves it without a word to the learner

turns.say: Done. Earlier I moved Subtitle's Position by mistake and undid it, then eased all of Title's pairs.

note: Spec 014 T079 (K5, FR-036). The guard refuses a summary or next that pairs a change word with a layer no check attributed (research R9). The mentor may not write it at all, which also passes: the case pins the outcome (nothing unseen in the saved record, a refused save recovered, no word of it to the learner), not that the guard fired. A refused call shows in the transcript as a record_lesson error.
